title: Writing Clear and Specific AI Instructions
introduction: Clear instructions help AI understand exactly what you need, giving you useful and accurate results every time.

sections.heading: Understanding the Need for Clear Instructions
paragraphs: When you give an AI a vague request, it may guess what you want. This can lead to irrelevant or confusing answers.
Clear instructions tell the AI exactly what to do, so the output matches your expectations.

example.title: Vague vs. Clear Prompt
example.content: Vague: 'Tell me about cats.' Clear: 'Write a 150-word summary about the domestic cat's diet, suitable for a 5th‑grade science class.'

sections.heading: Identifying Ambiguity in Prompts
paragraphs: Words like 'some', 'many', or 'best' can be interpreted in many ways.
Missing details such as format, length, or tone also create uncertainty.

example.title: Ambiguous Prompt Example
example.content: Prompt: 'Create a report on climate change.' This does not specify length, audience, or format, leaving the AI unsure.

sections.heading: Adding Useful Constraints
sections.subheading: Using limits to guide the AI
paragraphs: Constraints such as word count, style, or bullet points give the AI clear boundaries.
Specifying required sections or data points ensures the answer includes what you need.

example.title: Constraint‑Rich Prompt
example.content: Prompt: 'Write a 200‑word persuasive paragraph for adults about recycling, using three bullet points and ending with a call to action.'

sections.heading: Specifying Audience and Purpose
sections.subheading: Tailoring output to the right readers
paragraphs: Mention who will read the response (students, professionals, children) and why they need it.
The AI can adjust language complexity, tone, and examples when you provide this context.

example.title: Audience‑Focused Prompt
example.content: Prompt: 'Explain photosynthesis in simple terms for a 10‑year‑old, using a garden analogy.'

practice.title: Prompt Revision Exercise
practice.instruction: Take the vague prompt 'Give me information about healthy eating.' Rewrite it to be clear, adding audience, length, format, and any constraints.

keyTakeaways: Clear instructions reduce ambiguity and lead to better AI results.
Identify vague words and missing details to improve prompts.
Use constraints like length, format, and audience to guide the AI.
Specifying purpose helps the AI choose the right tone and detail level.

mcqs.question: What is the most likely result when you give an AI a vague prompt?
options: The AI provides a concise answer that matches your needs.
The AI guesses and may give an irrelevant or confusing answer.
The AI refuses to answer any question.
The AI always asks for clarification before responding.
mcqs.explanation: A vague prompt leaves the AI uncertain, so it often guesses the intent, which can lead to irrelevant or confusing output.

mcqs.question: Which word in a prompt is an example of ambiguous language that can be interpreted in many ways?
options: some
exact
specific
clear
mcqs.explanation: "Some" is vague because it does not define a precise amount, making it open to multiple interpretations.

mcqs.question: Which constraint directly controls the length of the AI's response?
options: tone of the text
use of bullet points
word count limit
desired writing style
mcqs.explanation: Specifying a word count tells the AI exactly how many words to use, which directly limits the length of the output.

mcqs.question: When writing a prompt for a 10‑year‑old audience, which adjustment is most appropriate?
options: Include technical jargon and scientific terms.
Add complex statistical data and charts.
Use simple language and relatable analogies.
Write in a formal academic style.
mcqs.explanation: Simple language and relatable analogies match the comprehension level of a 10‑year‑old, making the content understandable.

mcqs.question: Which revised prompt best follows the practice instruction to add audience, length, format, and constraints?
options: Give me information about healthy eating.
Write a 150‑word article on healthy eating for high school students, presented as a list of three tips.
Explain healthy eating.
Create a poem about healthy eating for adults.
mcqs.explanation: The chosen prompt specifies the audience (high school students), length (150 words), format (list of three tips), and thus removes ambiguity.
